name: SQLite on Web
description: A lightweight, browser-based SQLite editor and visual explorer. Features direct SQLite file loading, interactive data grids (add, edit, delete rows), virtualized table rendering for large datasets, autocomplete SQL console, and a Gemini AI assistant for natural language querying and error repair. Fully supports Japanese language interface / 日本語表示および日本語でのSQL生成・操作にも完全対応しています。
